correctness.rationale: For any nonconstant input each maximal zero-run of length at least two creates exactly two output one-sites. The two noncrossing adjacent pairings of 2m such markers are exhaustive and distinct. Intervening gaps of length g>=1 have exactly Fibonacci F_g binary fillings with first and last sites 1 and no 00; g=0 contributes zero. All-zero output has L_n+1 parents by the golden-mean trace plus all-zero source. Fibonacci phi bounds prove strict uniqueness for every n>=1. Direct exhaustive checks through n=18 and independent transfer-matrix calculations through n=180 test, but do not replace, this proof.
